title: A.R.I.A – Adaptive Responsive Intelligent Assistant
description: A fully functional voice-operated AI assistant available as both a Desktop app (Tkinter) and a Web app (Flask + vanilla JS), with real-time speech recognition and text-to-speech responses.
highlights: Voice-operated AI assistant (Web & Desktop)
Real-time Speech Recognition & Text-to-Speech
Animated, glowing dynamic status central orb UI
Deployed Flask web app on Render using Gunicorn
impact: Delivered a multi-interface voice assistant with high-accuracy speech processing and interactive status states.

title: Weather & AQI Monitoring Dashboard
description: A responsive web application providing real-time Air Quality Index and weather data for cities worldwide with interactive charts.
highlights: Real-time Weather & AQI tracking
OpenWeatherMap & AirVisual API integrations
Interactive data visualizations with Chart.js
Color-coded environmental health indicators
impact: Empowered users to make informed health decisions by tracking live localized environmental data.

title: Personal Developer Portfolio Website
description: A premium, fully responsive developer portfolio built to showcase project logs, expertise, and contact functions.
highlights: Fully responsive and modular React/Vite project log
Optimized production build and fast startup using Vite
Dynamic data-driven layout with easy updates via JSON files
Vercel CI/CD pipeline integrated with GitHub Actions
impact: Serves as a high-fidelity hub displaying and organizing developer experience and technical projects.

title: Authentication App
description: A full client-side authentication flow featuring signup/login, profile management, and a persistent To-Do List.
highlights: Secure sign-up, login, and profile dashboards
Dynamic light/dark theme switching support
Persistent user sessions using browser LocalStorage
Integrated search and task filtering capabilities
impact: Created an interactive utility showcase demonstrating state management and client-side persistence.

title: Expense Tracker
description: A responsive personal finance tracking app featuring category-based management and balance calculations.
highlights: Add/edit/delete income & expense transactions
Category-based sorting (Food, Travel, Bills)
Real-time balance updates and dynamic interface
Persistent state powered by Firebase & LocalStorage
impact: Provided a fluid personal ledger for organizing and checking daily transaction habits.

title: Walmart Sales Tracker
description: A Python-based sales analytics system designed to track customer orders, commission structures, and agent metrics.
highlights: SQL database managing customer, order, and staff entries
Calculates performance scores and sales commissions
Generates visual analytics charts using Matplotlib
Optimized query structures for high-performance retrieval
impact: Identified top-performing store attributes and clarified commission trends across operational periods.

title: Stopwatch Web Application
description: A responsive and clean stopwatch application with real-time lap recording features.
highlights: Start, pause, and reset features
Precise millisecond tracking and lap logging
Cross-browser mobile responsive layouts
impact: Engineered a precise utility demonstrating lightweight styling and DOM manipulation.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe Web Game
description: An interactive, clean two-player game featuring custom win-detection and game reset loops.
highlights: Dynamic draw, win, and win-combination algorithms
Fluid state reset transitions and active turn alerts
Responsive scaling layout suited for mobile touch targets
impact: Presented a lightweight, modular game script proving interactive layout efficiency.
